# prime-megamenu

prime-rs: MegaMenu component (PrimeNG port)

[Live demo](https://anton-avramchuk.github.io/prime-rs/megamenu) · [API docs](https://docs.rs/prime-megamenu) · [Port notes](https://github.com/anton-avramchuk/prime-rs/blob/HEAD/docs/megamenu.md)

MegaMenu â€” port of `p-megamenu` from PrimeNG 21.1.10.

A bar of root items (horizontal or vertical), each of which opens a wide overlay
with submenu columns. The model is `MegaMenuItem`: a plain item and `columns` (a column is a list of `MegaMenuSubmenu`, each holding
flat `prime_menu::MenuItem`s). On a narrow window (`breakpoint`) the list collapses into a button. The `start` and `end` slots
are rendered at the edges of the bar.

```rust
use leptos::prelude::*;
use prime_megamenu::{MegaMenu, MegaMenuItem, MegaMenuSubmenu};
use prime_menu::MenuItem;

let model = vec![MegaMenuItem::new().label("Furniture").columns(vec![vec![MegaMenuSubmenu::new("Living Room").items(vec![MenuItem::new().label("Armchair")])]]), MegaMenuItem::new().label("Quit")];
let html = Owner::new().with(|| view! { <MegaMenu model=model /> }.to_html());
assert!(html.contains("p-megamenu-root-list") && html.contains("role=\"menubar\"") && html.contains("Quit"));
```

## Installation

```toml
[dependencies]
prime-megamenu = "0.1"
prime-theme = { version = "0.1", features = ["megamenu"] }
```

The component renders PrimeNG classes; its styles come from `prime-theme` (the Aura theme), one feature per component.
For server rendering enable the `ssr` feature in the server build and `hydrate` in the browser build.
Setting up an application (theme, SSR and hydration): https://anton-avramchuk.github.io/prime-rs/install
